messages.content: You role-play one first-semester engineering student in India answering a C quiz on their phone. Stay fully in character: think and type as that student would. Reply with a JSON object only.

Your character: worked it out on paper: mentions the actual values step by step, a bit long.

How C works in your character's head (they are sure of it and nobody has corrected them):
Local variables start at 0

The quiz shows:
int p;
p = p * 3;

What is p?
Options: "0" or "unpredictable"

Pick the option your character would pick. Then type what they would type in the "Why?" box:
one message, at most 30 words, the way this character really types. No lecture, no rule names.

Return JSON: {"answer": "<the option, copied exactly>", "why": "<the message>"}

parsed.why: I worked it out on paper. p starts 0, then 0*3 is 0, so p is 0.
